messages:
Maya: Idea: 40m webinar titled 'Inference Playbook: Benchmarks -> Runbook -> Leads'. Keep it tactical.

Maya: Draft: quick 5m opener, two 12m demos (chat scale + embeddings bulk), 10m case study, 8m panel + Qs.

Jordan: Sounds good. Can we make the demos reproducible with a 1-command sandbox? Low friction increases follow-ups.

Elena: Agree. We'll add a tiny Docker sandbox + quickstart and show cost numbers in the dashboard.

Kai: I'll own chat demo (concurrency knobs + batching). Need ~12m. Will include a short table of config -> latency/cost.

Nora: I'll handle embeddings demo and case study handoff. Case needs customer permission; will confirm by EOD.

Maya: Rehearsal plan: tech check 30min before, full dry-run 2 days prior. Ops, can you pin a stage checklist?

OpsBot: [automated] Stage checklist created: https://redwood-stage/checklists/3188888888 :white_check_mark:

Jordan: Lead routing plan: standard webhook to SDR queue + tag high-fit via score>80. Also capture poll answer for follow-up segmentation.

Maya: Good. Also add 'book a follow-up' CTA slide and a one-click calendar flow for enterprise leads.

Kai: Will prepare recorded fallback demos; pushing them to recordings repo.

Nora: I'll draft the post-webinar email and a short FAQ to attach in follow-up.

Elena: Slide owners: intro (Maya), chat demo (Kai), embeddings (Nora), customer case (Nora), panel moderation (Jordan). Please upload slides by Mon noon.

Jordan: Sending rehearsal invites now. Will moderate live Qs and triage with Nora.

Maya: Final prep checklist: slides, sandbox repo link, fallback recordings, webhook mapping, poll wiring. Confirm here when done.

Kai: Sandbox repo pushed: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sandbox/tree/webinar-3188

Nora: Customer permission confirmed. Slides uploaded.

Elena: Poll wired to webhook.

Jordan: Rehearsal invite accepted by all. See you at dry-run. :rocket:
